text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Hm, hm... Oho. So, this could
work... Mhm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I approach the door to my office, I
hear Aston
Machan nearby mumbling to
herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. You're early today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Never mind. All that matters is that I'm
ready.
Come on, let's get right to
training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City, I just saw your new makeup
commercial! You
were so cool! That look
you gave at the end
literally blew my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Seize the moment."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't actually say that. Someone
else did
the narration.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I got some great material here.
How about
it? Wanna learn all about
motorcycles?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to. That's a topic I'd struggle to

familiarize myself with otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, not another step. I don't
care if you
are a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, she's right. Please turn around and
head
back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I continue to notice
Machan
behaving oddly from time to
time... Yet no matter
how I try to ask,
she stubbornly refuses to tell me
what
she's up to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But at the end of the day, just as I'm
about to
leave my office after work, I
notice something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The notebook Aston Machan always
keeps close
is here on the table. Did she
leave it behind?
Should I take it back to
her?
...Were you taking a sneaky peeky?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Machan?!" That's right, it's me. Are you

surprised? I bet you are.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But it's too late. You've already seen the
SSB I
carelessly left behind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, SSB. It stands for Super Secret
Book.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What's more, it's also short for Sales
Strategy
Book. I know, it's a rough title.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm researching sales tactics... And
basically, that
book contains my
findings.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been compiling advertising ideas,
slogans,
and ideas that come up when
learning about
hobbies I'm unfamiliar
with.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Information leaks can be catastrophic for
sales
strategies. They're very harmful to
the
entertainment value.
choice_data_list: それなら隠さなくても……
choice_data_list_en: In that case, you didn't have to hide it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But now my secrets have been leaked.
Oh no.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wow.
choice_data_list_en: ...By the way, I haven't looked yet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So I've gone and leaked my own secrets.
How
could I have been such a Mindless
Machan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While her behavior is often somewhat
baffling,
perhaps the truth is that she's
simply a very hard
worker with entirely
innocent motives...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's kind of you. I feel as if I've
gained an
unexpected ally.
choice_data_list: 研究のことは誰にも言わないよ
宣伝スキルあげ、協力させてほしい
choice_data_list_en: I won't tell anyone about the research.
Let me help you boost your promo skills.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course! You have, now you
mention it.
choice_data_list_en: I've been on your side from the start.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since you're my ally, I'll go
ahead and
share my findings with you. I
shall now begin my
presentation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan goes on to present her
advertising
research findings to me,
explaining them in a
uniquely rhythmical
tone...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Two heads would be better than one. And three would be better than two... Hm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But is that all right with you? Do you
have the
time?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing you mention "efforts" again
makes me
feel uneasy.
choice_data_list: 努力に見合う結果を出したいから
choice_data_list_en: Because I want results worthy of the effort.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're offering, then I'll accept.

Operation: Improve Machan's Mascot
Skills is a
go!
